_comment: Overlay of official USCCB celebration titles (bible.usccb.org daily readings page <title>) for dates where romcal's default English name is a folk/nickname title instead of the USCCB wording. Keyed by MM-DD. `name` is the value that should go in celebration.name (with the celebration type, e.g. 'Memorial'/'Solemnity', already implied by celebration.type — so the leading 'Memorial of the'/'Solemnity of the' from the USCCB page title is stripped). Applied both at generation time (generate-2026-skeleton.js and future skeleton generators) and retroactively to existing JSON via apply-usccb-overrides.js, so regenerating the calendar cannot silently reintroduce the folk name.

08-29.name: Passion of Saint John the Baptist
08-29.uscccbPageTitle: Memorial of the Passion of Saint John the Baptist
08-29.notes: romcal emits 'The Beheading of Saint John the Baptist, Martyr' (2026) / 'Passion of John the Baptist' (2025, missing 'Saint'). Only applies when the day is actually kept as this memorial (not when superseded by a Sunday, e.g. 2027-08-29).

09-23.name: Saint Pius of Pietrelcina, Priest
09-23.uscccbPageTitle: Memorial of Saint Pius of Pietrelcina, Priest
09-23.notes: romcal emits 'Saint Pio of Pietrelcina (Padre Pio), Priest'. USCCB uses the anglicized 'Pius' with no parenthetical nickname.

06-24.name: Nativity of Saint John the Baptist
06-24.uscccbPageTitle: Solemnity of the Nativity of Saint John the Baptist
06-24.notes: romcal emits 'Birth of John the Baptist'. USCCB uses 'Nativity'.
